name: Dekiai Caramelise
source:
You're a bookworm, so you decided to check out a library that had recently been renovated. The new interior design is aesthetically pleasing and the building smells new. Suddenly, you spotted a device you haven't seen before. "Remote Librarian? What's that?" - you thought, immediately curious. You tapped the screen, and then...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28690]Freem![/url]]
